# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Programmable GPU mesh drawing**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.159.0 introduces custom vertex meshes with SkSL programs for GPU-backed drawing. This unreleased line also fixes Apple device framework packaging and brings Skia m159 fixes for glyph rendering, image-filter caching, and Imagination Vulkan allocation failures.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## API Surface

- **Programmable vertex meshes** — Define SkSL vertex and fragment programs with SKMeshSpecification and its builder, then construct meshes with SKMeshBuilder or SKIndexedMeshBuilder and draw with SKCanvas.DrawMesh. Specifications support attributes, varyings, uniforms, and child effects; indexed meshes use 16-bit indices. Mesh drawing requires a GPU-backed surface and is a no-op on raster canvases. ([#5760](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5760))
- **Mesh buffers and resource lifetimes** — SKMeshVertexBuffer and SKMeshIndexBuffer provide Create, Copy, and Update operations for CPU-backed buffers and GRContext-based Ganesh GPU buffers. Updates require 4-byte size and offset alignment. Built meshes retain native resources after specification, builder, buffer, and child-shader wrappers are disposed; disposing a builder leaves its shared specification intact. ([#5760](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5760))

## Bug Fixes

- **Device-only Apple frameworks** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp iOS and tvOS device frameworks now use arm64 device binaries and device platform metadata, correcting simulator slices and metadata that could cause App Store rejection ITMS-90087. Separate simulator frameworks continue to include x86_64 and arm64 slices. — ❤️ [@kdpkke](https://github.com/kdpkke) ([#5649](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5649))
- **Glyph rendering and image-filter caching** — Mask-filtered glyph rendering uses reloaded glyph state when a scaler changes paths, mask formats, or bounds, clears incompatible masks, and correctly copies clipped emboss masks. Image-filter cache key equality now matches bytewise hashing, including signed zero, cached matrix type masks, and subnormal translations. ([#5741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5741), [#5769](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5769))
- **Imagination Vulkan out-of-memory handling** — Ganesh and Graphite abandon descriptor pools when allocation reports host or device out-of-memory on Imagination drivers, avoiding a driver failure when destroying the affected pool. Graphite also blocks further allocation through the abandoned handle. Other vendors and allocation errors are unaffected by this workaround. ([#5741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5741))
